ask.text: All 6 stills pass now. S1 is a fresh still: her right hand holds the RIGHT shoe (side tab on its outer edge), left foot in its shoe, right foot bare. sections.note: Open S1, save its 4 images, copy the prompt, make it in Flow (Gemini Omni Flash, 4 s, 12 credits), download at 1080 and send it back.

items.what: right shoe in her right hand, insole up, small tilt
items.prompt: Recreate image 1 exactly as the first frame: keep its bricks, light, framing, her skin, leggings, anklets, white toenails, her hand, nails, rings, blue band and bracelets exactly. Image 2 is the real red insole logo: a white rectangle with the red VANS skateboard-tail logo. Image 3 is the real woven side tab: a small black tab with white VANS letters. Image 4 is the real RIGHT shoe from above: the held shoe stays this RIGHT shoe the whole clip. Image 5 is the product sheet: keep this exact shoe shape, size, checkerboard and colours, no added marks, no extra text. Every mark matches its image letter for letter and colour for colour; only the black squares carry sequins. Motion: her right hand keeps the same grip and tilts the held shoe slowly about 10 degrees toward the lens and back. The red insole faces the camera for all 4 seconds; the shoe never turns onto its side, never shows its sole and never flips. Her feet stay still on the bricks: the LEFT foot in its shoe, the RIGHT foot bare. Exactly one hand, five fingers. Camera: handheld phone, steady. Vertical 9:16 phone footage, bright neutral overcast daylight, realistic skin, two shoes in frame. No sparkle effects, no music, no voice, no captions, no on-screen text.

sections.note: S1: two edits kept the left shoe, so it's a fresh still. S2 redone. S4 fresh, heel label colours fixed free (it came out black).
